query: Best street food spots and street food markets in Hanoi

places.title: Banh Mi 25
places.text: One of Hanoi's most famous street food spots, Banh Mi 25 is highly praised for its exceptionally crispy baguettes packed with fresh ingredients like pâté, pork, and pickled veggies. Grab a seat on the tiny stools across the street to soak in the bustling neighborhood atmosphere.
places.address: 25 P. Hàng Cá, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội 100000, Vietnam

places.title: Bún chả Hương Liên
places.text: Commonly known as 'Bun Cha Obama' after President Barack Obama and Anthony Bourdain famously dined here, this legendary multi-story spot offers classic Hanoian grilled pork patties over noodles in a sweet-savory broth, surrounded by local diner charm.
places.address: 24 P. Lê Văn Hưu, Cửa Nam, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Ta Hien Beer Street
places.text: The epicenter of Hanoi's nighttime street culture, Ta Hien Street is packed shoulder-to-shoulder with miniature plastic stools. It is the ultimate spot to pair cheap local draught beer (Bia Hoi) with fried fermented pork rolls, grilled skewers, and roasted peanuts.
places.address: 41-36 P. Lương Ngọc Quyến, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Gánh Hà Nội
places.text: A popular dining spot nestled in the Old Quarter that serves a wide array of classic Vietnamese street food delicacies. Highly favored by visitors for its clean, lively atmosphere and authentic street-style food platters.
places.address: 115 P. Hàng Buồm, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Chợ đêm Đồng Xuân - ngành hàng ẩm thực
places.text: The food alley of the legendary Dong Xuan Night Market comes alive with local Hanoian street treats. Wander through the dense stalls to find everything from hot pots and grilled meat skewers to sweet dessert soups (che) and traditional porridge.
places.address: 2RPX+WWW Chợ Đồng Xuân, Ng. Đồng Xuân, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam
